caveats: Regular-season week logs are not in the public export. Single-game records (highest, lowest, closest, blowout, combined) come from the 885-game SQLite archive via matchups.json.
Player-season scoring exists for 2019–2025 only, so draft steals, busts, and trade scoring start in Szn 3.
Trade outcomes use full-season player points, not remaining-season points after the deal week. A Week 2 swap is nearly a full year; a Week 12 swap is not.
Executed trades are the 85 recovered ESPN kona_playercard deals (2019–2025). 2017–2018 trades were not in that recovery set.

headlines.title: Jared and Tommy are tied at three. Everybody else is counting stories.
headlines.dek: Nine seasons. Five unique champions. George, Kyle, and JD have one each. The rest of the room is still looking for the first.

headlines.title: Seven playoff trips. Zero finals.
headlines.dek: Bryan Hunt has more playoff appearances than anyone without a title game. Two of those years he was the 1-seed.

headlines.title: Jared dropped 218.82 on Hash and left a 137-point crater.
headlines.dek: Week 5, 2021. Bishop Sycamore vs Team Hash. Still the biggest blowout in the 885-game book.

headlines.title: Kyle sent CeeDee to George in Week 2. George named the team after it and won the league.
headlines.dek: Dobbins and Pickens went back. CeeDee finished the year on A, B, Ceedee, **** You. The championship lived in the package.

headlines.title: Kyle flipped Bijan to Collin in 2024 Week 12. Collin kept him and ran Szn 9.
headlines.dek: JSN and Bucky went the other way. The 2025 club is still named Breezin’ with Bijan.

headlines.title: German lost thirteen in a row and backed it with last place twice.
headlines.dek: Lamb Fried Rice, 2025 Weeks 5–17, including the postseason. 2–12 in 2024. 2–12 in 2025.

headlines.title: Lamar Jackson in round 13 still looks like a crime.

titles.note: The Flash In The Flex beat George Travis to win the 2017 championship. Jared Hall finished the regular season 10–3 with a +259.8 point differential, earning the league's first 1048 Gate title.
Turn Goff the Lights beat George Travis 167.02–126.08 to win the 2018 championship. Kyle Fowler finished the regular season 9–4 with a +125.64 point differential, earning his first 1048 Gate title.
We're on to Cleveland beat Trevor Hash 156.84–131.2 to win the 2019 championship. JD Daley finished the regular season 8–5 with a +25.62 point differential, earning his first 1048 Gate title.

titles.championTeam: Has a Nice Ring to it
titles.note: Has a Nice Ring to it beat German Haro 165.3–107.16 to win the 2020 championship. Thomas Speer finished the regular season 7–6 with a +209.28 point differential, earning his first 1048 Gate title.

titles.championTeam: Has a Nice Ring to it
titles.note: Has a Nice Ring to it beat Kyle Fowler 130.6–109.16 to win the 2021 championship. Thomas Speer finished the regular season 9–5 with a +142.56 point differential, completing the league's first repeat and his second straight title.
A, B, Ceedee, **** You beat JD Daley 134.28–81.3 to win the 2022 championship. George Travis finished the regular season 8–6 with a +178.9 point differential, earning his first 1048 Gate title.
Crown The King beat JD Daley 126.12–121.2 to win the 2023 championship. Jared Hall finished the regular season 9–5 with a +150.28 point differential, earning his second 1048 Gate title.

The Diddlers beat George Travis 161.22–135.48 to win the 2024 championship. Jared Hall finished the regular season 11–3 with a +182.4 point differential, completing the repeat and his third 1048 Gate title.

The Swifties beat Collin Krum 129.64–107.88 to win the 2025 championship. Thomas Speer finished the regular season 11–3 with a +389.98 point differential, earning his third 1048 Gate title and tying the all-time league record.

trades.caveat: Net uses that season's full player points, not leftover weeks. Winner is the side with the higher net. 85 executed ESPN trades, 2019–2025.
